name: Jossa Pella
keeps: the weights, and the habit of checking them
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: Organised a poisoning campaign against planters.
text: Jossa pella of the open ledger, keeps a door for the 19th tranche, doors 172 to 180. Keeps the weights, and the habit of checking them. Reads François Makandal.
